name: Shin Koihime † Eiyuutan
source:
A collection of three low-priced sequels to the Koihime series, focusing on the Shoku generals. It is only available via download (DMM). It appears to occur in an alternate timeline from Shin Koihime Musou or Moeshouden. 

In the first release, the main heroines are Aisha, Sei and Sui, although there are also new characters, such as Sui’s younger sisters Ruo and Sou. With a NEXTON-PASSPORT, you can also enjoy an H-scene append for Touka and Renka.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《恋姬》系列的三部低价续作合集，主角聚焦于蜀国武将。只能通过下载版（DMM）获得。故事似乎发生在与《真·恋姬†无双》或《萌将传》不同的时间线。

第一部作品的主要女主角是爱莎、翠和星，同时还会登场翠的妹妹璐欧与穗等新角色。凭借NEXTON-PASSPORT，还可以游玩桃香与恋的追加H场景。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
